truth_boundary: This artifact starts evidence acquisition only. It does not create labels, independent reviewer attestations, blind-holdout labels, empirical attestation, Track B approval, publication or Production authorization.

lanes.rule: collect only real source records with payload digest, license evidence and provenance; no algorithmic label generation

lanes.blocker: STRICT_GRAMMAR_COMPLETE_REAL_RECORDS_7_OF_120; CROSS_AUTHORITY_ALIAS_PAIRS_7_OF_40; SAME_MODEL_DISTINCT_SERIAL_HARD_NEGATIVE_PAIRS_0_OF_40; Met accessionNumber alone is not a manufacturer serial or product reference
lanes.rule: count only records exposing maker/manufacturer P176, a P31 target with a product-model path, manufacturer serial P2598, and distinct inventory/reference P217 qualified by collection P195; Met accessionNumber alone contributes zero capacity
historical provenance/event semantics only; current market claims prohibited

use only MusicBrainz core database dump fields distributed under CC0; exclude supplementary/derived data, cover art and live replication feed unless separately rights-cleared; retain release/recording/barcode/disc identifiers only when present in the CC0 core payload

collect only Palissy MH PM records whose official textual payload explicitly co-asserts a physical collector-car denomination, exactly one maker role, model type and unambiguous chassis/serial text; use the deterministic 120-candidate manifest with 200 distinct source records, zero reuse and exact SOURCE_RECORD 35 / PHYSICAL_OBJECT 35 / CANONICAL_DESIGN 50 review axes so any future 60-case blind split is source-record disjoint; preserve candidates as unlabeled and review-required; exclude images and NHTSA vPIC; do not infer physical identity
